**C.** The littering ordinance is content-neutral and aimed at keeping the park clean, not at suppressing communication. Under *O'Brien* and *Spence*, even if dumping the trash is symbolic speech, the government may regulate it incidentally when the regulation serves an important interest unrelated to suppressing expression and burdens speech no more than necessary. Choice A is wrong because symbolic speech is not immune from neutral regulation. Choice B wrongly applies the *Brandenburg* incitement test, and choice D wrongly says conduct can't be communicative.

CONFIDENCE: 90
